texts.n01: Your ideas move between apps. Your work changes. But every time you switch tools, the context gets left behind.
texts.n04: Text, screenshots, documents, research. Shapr sorts them into context packs, so what you need doesn't vanish into another tab.
texts.n05b: Fill in what you already know.
texts.n06: Switch AI tools without starting over.
texts.n07c: Let your AI tools use what you've collected.
texts.n08: Next, we're designing Shapr to follow your workflow, with your permission. You choose which apps it can see, and what it's allowed to remember.
texts.n09: Instead of starting another conversation from zero, Lens brings what you already know to the spot where you're working.
texts.n10a: Not an endless recording of your screen.
texts.n10b: A compact working memory: your goal, what you've tried, and what comes next.
texts.n11: And when a decision gets complicated, explore the alternatives, and the evidence behind them.
texts.n12a: And when you come back, you don't have to start over.
texts.n12b: Shapr remembers the work, so you can focus on doing it.
texts.n02b: A companion that carries the context of your work across your computer.
texts.t01: Every time you switch tools, your context gets left behind.
texts.t02: Shapr keeps what matters in context packs.
texts.t03: Next: Shapr Flow. Your work, your permission.
texts.t04: Remember what matters. Forget the noise.
texts.T00: This is a tour of Shapr, using one project the whole way through: Aurora, a campus energy app, and a database that won't connect.
texts.T01a: Double-tap Command and circle anything on screen.
texts.T01a2: Shapr reads the text on your Mac, then offers to add it, or ask about it.
texts.T01b: Or highlight text and press Option C. Every capture keeps its source.
texts.T01c: Open a file while you work, and Shapr offers to add it.
texts.T01d: Capture the same thing twice, and it isn't saved twice.
texts.T02b: Hold Option S for the wheel, and point at a pack to equip it.
texts.T02c: The map shows what a pack holds, and what belongs together. It's worked out on your Mac.
texts.T03a: Ask a question, and Shapr answers from your notes.
texts.T03b: Each point cites its source. Answers run on your Mac, or with Claude if you add your own key.
texts.T03c: Ask about a screenshot, and the answer draws on the picture and your pack.
texts.T03d: Or use the pack with what you're looking at. You see what Shapr picked, and you can leave anything out.
texts.T04a: Hold Option V, and say what you want.
texts.T04b: Not sure what to say? Ask, and Shapr shows you.
texts.T05a: Shapr drafts from the pack, and only from the pack. Nothing is pasted until you press Insert.
texts.T05b: Forms are filled with values from your notes. You check each one. You press Submit.
texts.T05c: It picks the right pack for who you're writing to, and it can borrow your voice from a style pack, without taking facts from it.
texts.T05d: Passwords and IDs come only from your Vault, unlocked with Touch ID. Consent boxes are never ticked for you.
texts.T06a: Save progress, and Shapr drafts a checkpoint: your goal, your rules word for word, what you've tried, and what's next.
texts.T06b: When a free AI runs out of messages, Shapr hands the chat to another one.
texts.T06c: The handoff waits in the message box. You check it, and you send it.
texts.T06d: Resume in any tool. If something changed since you saved, Shapr tells you first.
texts.T07a: Share a pack as a live link. People who add it stay in sync, and anything private waits for your review.
texts.T08: Everything from here is a concept.
texts.T08a: You stay in control: pause the session, revoke an app, or delete what it remembered. Temporary details expire on their own.
texts.T09: Shapr isn't about collecting everything. It's about remembering what matters.
